The Transparency WG has completed the transparency audit this sprint. As part of the whole process, we are sharing our transparency checklist with the community for it to review the accuracy of our report. This is also a good opportunity to check if the process is efficient and effective for us to reach the goals of this initiative, which are mutual monitoring within the community and easy access to information. Here’s the link to our transparency checklist:

docs.google.com

Transparency WG Audit

General Process General Process For the audit to be successful, the working groups will prepare the documentation needed to fulfill the audit criteria/checklist. The WG will then answer the audit criteria/checklist and get feedback from members...

Would love you to check the audit and go through the documents and evaluate the scores we were giving are accurate. Feel free to provide any feedback, we’ll truly appreciate it!

The links to the Advice Process of the audits from the participating working groups are going to be added to our tracking database.
